info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking It Management Operational Gateway By Operational Gateway Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API supports the modification of existing banking IT management operational gateways identified by their unique ID. It allows authorized users to update various attributes of the operational gateway, ensuring that the IT management processes are aligned with the current operational needs. Typical consumers include banking IT administrators and devops teams involved in maintaining and optimizing IT systems. By using this endpoint, organizations can efficiently manage their operational gateway configurations and respond to changing business requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of the specified operational gateway resource identified by RES-100045. Users should provide the necessary fields in the request to execute the update successfully.
